Application and Admission
Before submitting the application dossier to the Graduate School of Precision Engineering GSPRE, potential students must themselves organise a research project and supervisor. Open PhD positions can be found on the websites of the University of Bern, participating institutes and recognized industry partners. Those with a foreign master's degree need to register at the University of Bern before signing their employment contract.
